paite: Huai ni chiang in Judahte gam ah hiai la asa ding uh. Khopi kiptak i nei ua; ama'n hotdamna kulhbaangte leh kulhpite a ding in asep ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Amite Avualzousak Ding
english: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

paite: Nam diktat thutak zui nam a luttheihna ding in kulh kongkhakte hong un.
english: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

paite: Na tung a lungsim ngami, nangmah ahon muan ziak in, muanna kim in na kem ding.
english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in muang un; TOUPA, Jehovah ah lah tangtawn suangpi a-om ngal a.
english: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

paite: Ama'n sangpi a omte ahihniam a khopi sangpi mah; akoihniam a, lei pha in akoihniam a, leivui pha hial in apuksak hi.
english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

paite: Khe in asikden ding; gentheite khe leh tagahte kalsuan in.
english: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.”

paite: Midiktat lampi lah dikna ahi a; nang lungtang diktat pu in midiktat lampi na hihmam sek a.
english: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA aw, na vaihawmna lampi ah ka hon ngak uhi; kou hinna deih zaw na min loh leh nangmah theihgigena ahi.
english: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, we have waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

paite: Zan chiang in ka hinna in nangmah ahon ngai a; ahi, zingkhang in ka sung a ka kha om in ka hon zong ding hi; na vaihawmnate leitung a ahong om chiang in khovel a omte'n diktatna lah asin zel ngal ua.
english: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me I will seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are on the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

paite: Mithulim lou deihsak in om mahleh, diktatna asin tuan sam kei ding; dikna gam ah dikloutak in ahih ding hi. TOUPA thupina amu tuan kei ding.
english: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.

paite: TOUPA, na khut zak in a-om a, himahleh amau amu tuan kei ua; himahleh mite a dia na phatuamngaihna amu ding ua, azum ding uh; ahi, nang hon doute mei in akangmang ding hi.
english: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

paite: TOUPA nang lemna na hon sehsak ding; nang ka nasep tengteng uh na hon sepsak hi.
english: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang kia hilou in kumpipa dangte'n leng ka tung uah thu anei khinta ua, himahleh na min kia ka louta ding uh.
english: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.

paite: Amau lah asita uh a, ahing nawn kei ding uh; amangta ua, athounawn kei ding uh; huaiziak in nang amaute gawt in na hihsia a, atheihgigena teng uh leng na hihmangta hi.
english: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

paite: Hiai nam na pungsakta a, TOUPA aw, hiai nam na pungsak a; nang pahtawi in na omta; hiai gam a gamgite na hihlian hi.
english: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

paite: TOUPA, adah lai un ahon zong ua, amau na thunun chiang in athum zel uhi.
english: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

paite: Numei naupai, neih hun naita bang in; TOUPA aw, kou na ma ah ka om uhi.
english: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs, so we have been before you, Yahweh.

paite: Nau ka pai ua, ka na ua, huih bang lel ka nei uh; lei ah lah tatkhiakna lam himhim ka ngah kei ua; khovel a omte lah apuk sam kei uhi.
english: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance on the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

paite: Na misite ahing nawn ding ua; ka misi luang toh athounawn ding uh. Leivui a omte aw, halh unla, nuamtak in la sa un; na daituite khovak daitui bang ahi a, lei in misite apaikhe ding hi, chih.
english: Your dead shall live. Their dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.

paite: Kisa un, ka mite aw, na dantan sungte ah lut unla, na kongkhakte uh kikhakkhum un; lung hihlouhna aven masiah sawt lou sung kibu un.
heading: Pathian Vaihawmna
english: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA, agitlouhna ziak ua lei a omte gawt ding in a-omna a kipan ahong pawtkhe ding a; lei mah in asisan ahihlang dia, ami athahte uh akhuhta kei ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
